strings.subtitle: — Fiŋolu labaŋo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ñaaniŋ bokaŋo te jaŋ. Ñiŋ botoŋo duuma la.
strings.ft_lnk: Sila kuruŋ (.lnk) — a be batu la
strings.ssd_warning:
Kebaa! SSD kaŋ, tiliŋ saafoŋo maŋ sabari labaŋo la TRIM la.
Ñiŋ porogaraamu ye HDD ye.
strings.confirm_text:
Fiŋo "{name}" be saafoŋo la kaŋ, a be bo la.

Ñiŋ ñaata?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Ñiŋ mu shortcut le ti (.lnk). Shortcut faŋo dɔrɔŋ be tumboo la.

A target fáayili be tu a nooma.

Ñoo?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Ñiŋ mu network drive le ti (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite man tu ñiŋ tumboo la — server be noo ka snapshot, deduplication waraŋ CoW soto.

Ñoo?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Ñiŋ mu removable drive le ti (USB / HDD konko).
Controller be noo ka block jaŋolu mara reserve kono.

Ñoo?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Fiŋo maŋ ke a karaŋ no la:
{err}
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS sila doomaa data (ADS) maŋ dookuwo ke.
• USN kitaaboo maŋ sama.
• Ndiyaa koppiŋolu niŋ saŋ fatariŋolu
  (OneDrive, atg.) maŋ bata.
strings.status_full: A kono bee saafoŋo kaŋ niŋ zeri la. A maŋ ñaama — kuranko be zeri doroŋ ne je.
strings.status_fast: Kuuŋ, kuntu, niŋ 4 MB siriŋolu saafoŋo kaŋ. A toomaa maŋ bata, saayiŋ baa la, labaŋo bee kuranko maŋ ñaama. Kunnafoni dogolu ye FAA mode taa.
strings.status_empty: Fiŋo faŋka, saafoŋo maŋ ñaata. A bota.
strings.error_permission: Man noo ka fáayili soto. A be noo ka open program doo kono. A daa loo, i lafiyaa a la.
strings.error_not_found: Fáayili man je. A be noo ka tumboo ke a la.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ñiŋ mu symbolic link le ti. Linkolu man noo ka tumboo — target fáayili be tu a nooma.
strings.error_reparse: Ñiŋ mu placeholder fáayili le ti (OneDrive waraŋ doo). A data be cloud kono, disk kono te — tumboo te a la jaŋ.
strings.error_not_file: Ñiŋ mu fáayili te (folder waraŋ doo). Fáayili laa.
strings.error_hardlinks: Ñiŋ fáayili be hard link doo la ({n} bee). Hard linkolu man soto kuntiyo — toolu bee kiliŋ ne. Niŋ i ye a tumboo ñiŋ sila la, data be overwrite la aniŋ a be kuntu 32 bytes la, kɔɔ a too be tu a je la link doolu la. Bo linkolu bee foloo.
strings.error_compressed:
Fáayili be compress la, encrypt la waraŋ a sparse ne. Zero overwrite man tu data jaŋolu tumboo la kaatu NTFS be a mara la koteŋ.

Bo attribute la: right-click → Properties → Advanced → bo 'Compress' aniŋ/ waraŋ 'Encrypt' la. A koola, SHREDDER bugo.
strings.queue_hint: (waraŋ fáayili ì laa ñiŋ windoo kono)
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ A be loo la fáayili hii koola...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Fáayili {count} be tumboo la.
Ñoo bee: {size}.

A lafiyaa siloo la.
Ñiŋ baaraa man fara.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Bo fáayili {count} bee la queue kono?

Fáayili faŋo TÉ TAAMA — queue duuma.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fáayili "{name}" be hard link doo la ({nlink} bee).

Data be tumboo la ñoo bee la.
Kɔɔ a too (32 bytes) be tu ñoo doo kono folder kono.

A si ke i lafiyaa ka ñiŋ too bo i bulu.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: A ke hard link bee la queue kono
